reviewType: Bounded browser-assisted first-use comprehension review; not the Final Visual / Product QA screenshot campaign

environment.browser: Codex in-app browser (Chromium family; exact version unavailable)
environment.input: Browser accessibility tree plus direct visual inspection

questions.question: Can a first-time reviewer identify the intended journey direction?
questions.evidence: The primary instruction explicitly says to read left to right from shared foundations through domain branches to targets; the Map follows that progression.

questions.question: Can the reviewer identify domain branches and specialization hierarchy?
questions.evidence: The domain branch rail separates cross-domain targets, four learning domains, and graph foundations; Outline labels specialization children explicitly.

questions.question: Can the reviewer distinguish current capability from target state?
questions.evidence: Node summaries and the detail panel present Current, Target, Comparison, Confidence, and Freshness as separate facts.

questions.question: Can the reviewer identify Today work?
questions.evidence: Today is visible as text and an icon/status badge in Map, Outline, the domain counts, and the focused detail context.

questions.question: Can the reviewer identify a blocked or Unknown prerequisite state?
questions.evidence: Unknown capability and prerequisite-status-unknown labels are visible without relying on color, with exact relationship state in Outline/details.

questions.question: Does selecting a target make the complete prerequisite closure dominant without inventing a single path?
questions.evidence: Focusing a target marks every relevant prerequisite/branch item as Focused path, exposes the relationship list, and enables Fit path while retaining branching relationships.

questions.question: Is collapse/expand meaningful while a focused path is active?
questions.evidence: Collapsing the selected domain reduces it to the two relevant items and labels the branch temporarily revealed instead of hiding required closure.

questions.question: Do Map and Outline preserve the same facts and actions?
questions.evidence: The focused item retained current/target/Today/review/path context and the same detail/actions when switching to Outline. Automated parity coverage provides the exact assertion set.

acceptableTradeoffs: At Fit all, the 25-node Map is an orientation overview and individual labels are intentionally secondary; selection/Fit path and Outline are the reading modes.
The horizontally scrollable domain rail is an intentional local navigation region; automated checks confirm no page-level horizontal overflow.
